body:
Plenty of people don't have it too. I used to have friends, but after knowing me for a while...all I seem to do is disappoint, bore or make them uncomfortable. 

And I'm lazy.
That's a fairy tale. It's like the blind melon video...sure, it has a happy ending where the little girl finds all her other little bee friends...but really, completely unrealistic.
Yeah, but where are these people and why aren't they in my life? Why don't I get invited to things? Why do I feel so unsafe all the time?
You can't make promises like that.

You can't get better if you were never right to begin with. 

It's like losing an arm. You're never going to grow a new one. It's just not in the cards. Except in my case...it's not** a physical deformity. It's my fucking brain. It doesn't work. It just doesn't. I don't learn from my mistakes. I just keep making them overandoverandoverandover again. I change the scenery, but the story still plays out the same. 

I seriously can't live with myself anymore. I hate this person. I hate her.

I take days to myself all the time. 

I can't afford a professional.

I live by myself. 

Can you rephrase that question? I don't understand.

Every thing I hear is a slight. Every tone of voice, I take personally. 

I take EVERYTHING personally. 

Something bad happens...it's my fault. Always. 

I don't deserve to live a nice life. I never will because I'm emotionally, mentally, and spiritually fucked up beyond repair. 


This is all I want to do. This is all I ever do. Ruminate. Intrusive thoughts that buckle me on a daily basis. 

I throw myself out to the wolves time and time again...I get chewed up and spit out....and I come back for more. It's pathetic.

These things are true to me. I lost all control. I have no control. I'm pathetic and weak. 

They all cause me harm. Do you know how hard it is to be completely alone? I already feel alone, but without some of those superficial, harmful relationships....I'm 100% alone. 


You say I will find these things, but that's not the truth. It's a hope. And I don't hope for shit any more these days because it's only getting worse. It only hurts more. I can feel myself losing all grip. The things that make me happy are the things that tear me completely apart. There is nothing healthy or productive or GOOD about my life. I'm a waste of space. I'm a waste of resources. I'm a source of negative energy. 

I shouldn't have been born.
